retained_civil_dates.reason: Preserve existing subscription coverage while the full 2027 annual edition is reviewed.

corrections: Rosary appointed October 7; obsolete October 4 Rosary office and commemorations removed.
Simple octave days are commemorations only. Bruno is principal October 6.
III Class feasts have First Vespers only; I and II Class feasts retain both Vespers.
October 30 Holy Relics remains the II Class principal feast; its duplicate restored-name commemoration is removed. Existing event UIDs and all other event records are preserved.

All Souls retains I Class precedence as a special commemoration ending after None. November 2 moves to First Vespers of Blessed Simon Ballacchi; the November 3 transfer branch uses Saint Charles. Only November 2 is revised in the 2026 feeds; other events and all UIDs remain unchanged.
